title: We stopped building an AI stock picker. Here's why.
author: MoTA_AI
selftext:
Most AI investing tools focus on generating answers.

While building ours, we realized the bigger problem wasn't finding ideas—it was challenging them.

Professional investment teams don't make decisions with one opinion. Research gets reviewed, assumptions get questioned, risks get challenged, and only then does capital get allocated.

That led us to build an AI workflow with specialized agents instead of a single assistant.

We're now testing this approach with a small group of early users, and it's already changing how we think about AI in investing.

**I'm curious:** if AI were part of your investment process, where would you actually trust it—and where wouldn't you?
